Application Data.NAME: CineMedia Plus LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CineMedia Plus LLC is a video and media store that specializes in the rental and sale of a diverse range of films, documentaries, and video games. Our business operates both a physical storefront and an online platform, providing customers with access to a curated selection of media products and electronic equipment. We focus on customer service and aim to foster a community of film and media enthusiasts through special events and screenings hosted in-store. Our premises are equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system, including burglar and fire alarm systems, and we maintain strict inventory controls to deter theft. We also conduct regular employee training on safety and loss prevention measures.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: CineMedia Events LLC, 456 Elm Street, Springfield, IL 62701-1235, offering community film screenings and media workshops.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a theft incident occurred at our storefront where five high-value video game consoles were stolen. The estimated loss amount was $2,500. The incident was reported to the local authorities, and the case remains under investigation. As of now, we have not recovered any stolen items. Additionally, during a routine inventory check on June 10, 2023, $2,500 worth of damaged DVDs were identified due to water leakage from an overhead pipe. These DVDs were disposed of, and we have taken measures to repair the leak and prevent future incidents. Both losses have been documented, and no claims have been filed against the insurance policy.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Professional security monitoring service and regular employee safety training sessions.
